summary: Kitchen Tutorial State-Machine frontend testing. Tested all Playwright-accessible flows: intro dialog, soup fly/landing, SOUP_AVAILABLE dialog, SOUP_ON_TABLE state, tooltip show/dismiss, and tutorial persistence. Drag-to-consume (GestureDetector Pan) could not be triggered via Playwright without touch context.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot test via Playwright mouse events. react-native-gesture-handler Pan gesture requires touch events. Playwright browser context does not have touch enabled, so touchscreen.tap() fails and synthesized TouchEvent dispatches do not trigger RNGH Pan gesture. This affects testing of: consume flow, stamina animation, +20 float, avatar change, POST_DIALOG, QUESTION_CHOICE, WHERE_AM_I, WHO_ARE_YOU, NAME_INPUT, FINAL_DIALOG.

react_native_issues.issue: Reanimated warning: 'Reading from value during component render'. Not breaking but logged consistently. Line: staminaSV.value in useAnimatedStyle during render. Low priority.

action_items: DnD testing (consume soup → stamina animation → POST_DIALOG → QUESTION_CHOICE → NAME_INPUT → FINAL_DIALOG) requires manual testing on a real device or Expo Go, since Playwright web preview cannot simulate RNGH Pan gestures without touch context.
Consider adding a testID bypass button or debug mode for automated testing of post-consume flows.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical code issues found. Avatar change is immediate (staminaCurrent state, not staminaDisplay) which correctly satisfies 'Avatar wechselt SOFORT' requirement.
consumedOnce.current guard prevents double consumption - correct.
checkBothAnswered uses askedWhereRef + askedWhoRef (refs not state) to avoid stale closure issues - correct pattern.
onFinalDialogDone saves staminaCurrent to AsyncStorage - will be 40 after consumption, correct.
Tutorial-DONE check at load uses @tutorial:kitchen_done AsyncStorage key - persistence confirmed working.

success_rate.frontend: 70% - All button/dialog flows pass; DnD gesture untestable via Playwright
